sources.notes: Living page, content as seen on 2026-10-05. Lists perplexity/sonar as Perplexity's grounded search model; no other Sonar model id is listed. The old model-cards address https://docs.perplexity.ai/guides/model-cards now redirects (308) here.

sources.title: Changelog
sources.notes: Living page; content as seen on 2026-10-05. Entries carry month labels only. Its oldest entry is the April 2024 Model Deprecation Notice, shortened to its first five model ids (codellama-70b-instruct, mistral-7b-instruct, mixtral-8x22b-instruct, pplx-7b-chat, pplx-7b-online); the February 2024 entries and the sonar-small and sonar-medium ids are no longer on it. Old readme.io addresses such as https://docs.perplexity.ai/changelog/api-updates-february-2024 and https://docs.perplexity.ai/changelog/changelog redirect (308) here.

sources.title: Changelog
sources.notes: Earlier version of the Perplexity API changelog at its December 2024 address; the URL now redirects (308) to https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog, which no longer carries the February 2024 entries or the full April 2024 deprecation list. Checked in the capture: the April 2024 Model Deprecation Notice lists all thirteen ids removed as of May 14, including sonar-small-chat, sonar-small-online, sonar-medium-chat, sonar-medium-online, pplx-70b-chat and pplx-70b-online, and the API Updates February 2024 entry is present.

sources.title: API Updates February 2024

publishedAt.note: From the createdAt timestamp in the page data (2024-02-23T23:21Z, the same calendar day in US time); the capture of 2024-02-24 15:43Z shows about 16 hours ago.

sources.notes: readme.io changelog post by Aarash Heydari. The URL now redirects (308) to https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/changelog, which no longer contains this entry. Checked in the capture: launch of sonar-small-chat, sonar-medium-chat, sonar-small-online and sonar-medium-online; context windows of all Perplexity models doubled from 8k to 16k; pplx-70b-chat and pplx-70b-online no longer available as of March 15.

sources.title: Model Deprecation Notice

publishedAt.note: The page data gives createdAt 2024-05-07T03:53Z (the evening of 6 May in US time) and the capture of 2024-05-13 shows 7 days ago, so no day is recorded. The live changelog labels the same notice April 2024.

sources.notes: readme.io changelog post by Aarash Heydari; the slug suggests it was first titled as a Llama 3 Sonar launch post, but the capture shows the title Model Deprecation Notice. The URL returned 404 on 2026-10-05. Checked in the capture: as of May 14 the names pplx-7b-chat/pplx-7b-online, sonar-small-chat/sonar-small-online, pplx-70b-chat/pplx-70b-online, pplx-8x7b-chat/pplx-8x7b-online and sonar-medium-chat/sonar-medium-online are no longer available; users are told to switch to models from the Llama 3 family, among them llama-3-sonar-small-32k and llama-3-sonar-large-32k (chat and online).

sources.title: Image Attachments with Sonar
sources.notes: Says Sonar models support image analysis through uploads (base64 or HTTPS URL), shows a request with model sonar-pro, and lists as a limitation that sonar-deep-research does not support image input. The April 2025 changelog entry links this guide. The URL now redirects (308) to https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/agent-api/image-attachments, a different (Agent API) page.

sources.title: Migrate from Sonar to the Agent API
sources.notes: Living page, content as seen on 2026-10-05. States that Sonar Chat Completions support ended on September 27, 2026, that synchronous and streaming requests keep working and are being reformulated as Agent API requests (rolling out gradually by model) and that asynchronous Sonar requests are no longer supported. Maps Sonar and Sonar Pro to the fast preset, Sonar Reasoning Pro to low and Sonar Deep Research to high.
